skills.name: clarifai-agentic-flows
skills.description: Orchestrate multi-step Clarifai workflows. Use when the user needs to combine multiple Clarifai operations (e.g., "upload AND train", "train THEN deploy"), build end-to-end ML pipelines, or design composite workflows.

skills.name: clarifai-cli
skills.description: Execute Clarifai operations using the `clarifai` CLI. Covers model init, serve, deploy, status, logs, undeploy, predict, compute orchestration, and all model/pipeline operations.

skills.name: clarifai-datasets
skills.description: Upload and manage datasets on Clarifai platform. Covers image datasets with annotations (classification, detection, segmentation), data format conversion (COCO, VOC, YOLO), and DataLoader classes.

skills.name: clarifai-deployment-lifecycle
skills.description: Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of Clarifai deployments. Covers CLI-first deploy/status/logs/undeploy workflow, version tracking, and state transition monitoring.

skills.name: clarifai-grpc
skills.description: Direct API interaction using Clarifai's gRPC client and protobufs. Use for low-level platform operations, complex multi-modal inputs, or log retrieval.

skills.name: clarifai-inference
skills.description: Discover model capabilities and generate inference code. Covers model discovery, method signatures, code generation, OpenAI-compatible API, and agentic models with MCP tool calling.

skills.name: clarifai-mcp
skills.description: Create MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers on Clarifai. Covers MCPModelClass, StdioMCPModelClass, FastMCP tool definitions, and bridging external stdio MCP servers.

skills.name: clarifai-model-upload
skills.description: Upload and deploy custom models to Clarifai platform. Covers toolkit templates (vLLM, SGLang, Ollama, HuggingFace), ModelClass implementation, config.yaml, GPU configuration, and local testing.

skills.name: clarifai-observability
skills.description: Debug and monitor Clarifai resources (Runners and Pipelines). Use when a deployment is stuck, crashing, or failing. Covers CLI logs, K8s events, and common resolution patterns.

skills.name: clarifai-pipelines
skills.description: Create and run Clarifai pipelines for batch processing and multi-step workflows. Covers containerized steps, Artifacts API for data transfer, and DAG orchestration.

skills.name: clarifai-training-pipelines
skills.description: Train models using Clarifai pipeline templates. Covers built-in templates (classifier-pipeline-resnet, detector-pipeline-yolof) and custom training pipelines.
